residuals: No execution in this shard; parent test run pending.
GPU evaluator does not record faults (ADR 2849 deferred). `function_faults_after_drawing` is an API the host must ask; it does not retroactively make the rendering report complete.
A low-bit one-component image palette evaluates all representable levels, so it may report a fault at a level absent from the image (explicitly retained in ADR 2848).
No exhaustive independent PLRM3 numeric audit of every operator here.

PLRM3 requires zero-filled bits, but §3.3.1 and Appendix B.1 make machine integer width implementation-dependent/typical; exact width-32 results and shifts >=32=>0 are local i32 behavior, not universal source mandates.

PLRM3 §8.2 requires both bitshift operands be integers; current Value::integer truncates real values, and a unit test explicitly accepts real 1.5. Treat this as malformed-operand recovery/departure, not valid operator semantics.
No host calls Interpretation::function_faults_after_drawing; viewer-core formats initial Unsupported reports only, so a post-draw Type 1 shading fault has no visible host warning currently.
